reply: {"action": "answer", "text": "The guideline corpus recommends surgical excision as the first-line management for melanoma. Specifically, when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin (1–3 mm) to perform histological diagnosis. For primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness or melanoma in situ, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended, with margins based on tumor thickness. Sentinel lymph node biopsy, if indicated, should be performed before wide excision and ideally in the same operative setting.
